eyebrow: Microsoft Azure Administration, Compute & Storage · Chapter 4
subtitle: Lesson 14 · Azure Storage

eyebrow: A flat namespace, inside an account
code:
az storage container create \
  --account-name ltvstorage01 \
  --name db-backups \
  --auth-mode login
caption: Containers hold blobs; slashes in blob names only look like folders.

steps.label: Hot
steps.sub: highest storage cost, no retrieval delay — frequent access

steps.label: Cool
steps.sub: lower storage cost, still fast — infrequent access, 30+ days

steps.label: Archive
steps.sub: cheapest storage, offline — rehydration can take hours

code:
az storage blob upload \
  --account-name ltvstorage01 \
  --container-name db-backups \
  --name 2026-10-28-nightly.bak \
  --file ./2026-10-28-nightly.bak \
  --tier Cool
caption: Past the first week, this backup moves from Hot to Cool.
